chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abi al-Sabbah al-Kinani, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who performed wudu (ablution) but forgot to wipe over his head until he had stood in salat (prayer).
He عليه السلام said: "Then let him turn away, wipe over his head, and repeat the salat (prayer)."

key_terms.رَأْسِهِ: his head, the place to be wiped in wudu
key_terms.فَلْيَنْصَرِفْ: let him turn away or leave the prayer
key_terms.يَمْسَحَ: to wipe, specifically the required wiping of the head in wudu

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they forgot to wipe their head in wudu until after starting salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on one who omitted the wiping of the head in wudu (ablution) and only remembered after beginning salat (prayer). Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instructs that he must leave the prayer, complete the missed act of wudu, and then repeat the prayer, indicating the necessity of proper ritual purity for valid salat.
